a_verdict_of_mine_is_REVERSED_by_the_rev.what: I classified builder-s7-always-recent as MOVES THE EMITTED ACTION, ABSORBED BY DEFAULTS, a fourth null class, because the baseline already resolved to RECENT and the two reached tokens_for_representation identically.
a_verdict_of_mine_is_REVERSED_by_the_rev.now: the baseline resolves to D2 and always-recent names RECENT, so they NO LONGER reach the charging path identically. The mechanism now moves BOTH axes and the arm is ELIGIBLE on comparability as well as credit.
a_verdict_of_mine_is_REVERSED_by_the_rev.lesson: that null class was REGIME-SPECIFIC, not structural. It was a true statement about the tree it was measured on and is false on this one. Absorbed-by-defaults is a property of the default, so any such verdict must name the regime it was taken under, the same way a single-size verdict must name its size.
a_verdict_of_mine_is_REVERSED_by_the_rev.same_applies_to: simplestream, which was identical to the baseline in effect under the old default and is now distinct from it.

a_correction_to_the_brief.claim: that after the revert the pre-default capture at Policy.__call__ is the ONLY surviving record that one arm decided and another declined to.
a_correction_to_the_brief.finding: not quite, and session 1 has already closed it. RecallAction now carries representation_defaulted (interface.py:208), set in apply_defaults at interface.py:257, carried through coordinator.py:447 and :583-584 and :866 and :882, and present in the schema at schema.py:318. The decision log is self-sufficient on the credit axis.
a_correction_to_the_brief.consequence: my emitted-action observable is now a CROSS-CHECK rather than the only evidence, which is the stronger position: two independent routes, the log-side one of which would regress silently if the flag were ever dropped.
a_correction_to_the_brief.one_caution: coordinator.py:447 reads it as getattr(ra, "representation_defaulted", False). That is safe here because the dataclass guarantees the field, but it is the same idiom that pinned cascade-routing lambda, and a duck-typed action object lacking the field would be silently recorded as CHOSEN when it was injected.

regimes: Regime 3 restores Regime 1 charging outcome by a different route, so rows from both are comparable on what a non-naming arm was charged. No row of mine is Regime 2: the only things measured in that window were the eco-llm reconciliation legs, which named their representation explicitly and were unaffected either way.
